title: Alex Dietrich on ufologists enjoying anticipation

tellings.quote: I'll give the last word to Dietrich who witnessed the 2004 UAP incident from the USS Nimttz fighter jet as I think it well sums up 75 years of ufologist search for aliens.

plain: Alex Dietrich, a Navy pilot who saw the 2004 incident in which fighter jets from the aircraft carrier USS Nimitz met an unexplained flying object, has said that UFO enthusiasts seem to enjoy the anticipation of an answer. Michael Shermer, billed as America's top skeptic, quotes her on Michels' show and gives her the last word, saying her remark sums up 75 years of the hunt for aliens.
